close_reason: Documented RateLimited as reserved for extension crates (Option B from the bead). Zero behaviour change; the variant remains in the public API for extension crates that detect 429 themselves. Caller diagnostic path (match on Http + HttpError::status()) is now explicit in the docstring. Rustdoc + clippy + fmt + tests clean.
description: src/error.rs:111 — `RateLimited { retry_after: jmap_types::UTCDate }` is defined and exhaustively matched in the test, but no code path in the crate produces it. HTTP 429 responses fall through `error_for_status()` and surface as `ClientError::Http`. The variant exists in the public API contract — callers may match on it — but the crate never emits it, so the contract is unobservable. Either: (a) add HTTP 429 detection that parses Retry-After and produces this variant, (b) document explicitly that this variant is reserved for extension crates, or (c) remove. Note: this crate is locked, so any actual change requires user approval. Filing for visibility.
title: ClientError::RateLimited variant is unreachable from this crate
